name: Starboard
summary: A review summary with a score dial and rating bars that filter the reviews and update as you post
about: A customer reviews section for a pair of handmade leather sandals. A gold dial fills to the average while the five rating bars grow and the numbers count up. Tap a bar or a topic chip to filter the reviews below: cards fade out, glide into place and rise in. Write a review slides in a form with a star picker that pops and sparkles; posting it drops your card at the top and re-counts the average, the bars and the dial.
how: Tap a rating bar (for example 5 stars) or a topic chip like Comfort to filter the reviews; tap it again or press Clear to show all.
Press Helpful on a review to add your vote; press again to take it back.
Press Write a review: pick 1 to 5 stars (hover to preview, arrow keys work too) and write at least 12 characters.
Press Post review: the button fills, ticks, and your card drops in at the top while the dial, bars and average update.
Cancel or Escape slides back to the reviews without posting.
